backbone_exposure: The adapted backbone may have seen these source cohorts without labels during domain adaptation. This probes shift for the gold-trained scoring head, not a guaranteed never-seen domain for the full system.
cohort_sampling: target-blind random subset with the experiment seed
interpretation: Compare base and new model within each cohort. Do not rank these weak-label MAEs against the gold validation MAE or use the cohorts to tune the gold model.
